overclaims: Some later reporting traces back to documents obtained by Zitron, although it also reports independent Financial Times verification.
checks.note: Excerpt is verbatim. Axis, horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. Fail 1: the limitation saying later reporting traces back to documents Zitron obtained has no support in the evidence. e2 mentions leaked documents but names no source. Fail 2: e2's public excerpt, 'nearly $39 billion in 2025.', is cut so short that it no longer says this is a net loss. It also leaves out that the figure includes a one-off charge of about $30B. The rest of the rationale fits the evidence. The ~$13.1B revenue can be worked out from e2's operating-loss ratio.
